description: Inspect the three WEAK signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety) which each show only 3 distinct values across 34 fingerprints. Run enrichment_harness.py against the v2 variants: tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2.py, temporal_stability_enrichment_v2.py, permission_scope_enrichment.py. Report: (a) how many distinct scores each produces, (b) which metadata fields are actually consumed, (c) whether the compute_score() calls are pure. Signals need 20+ distinct scores to pass the discrimination heuristic.
